race.description: Premier Racehorse - Pride Of Venus Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BRITISH NAVY (3) has gotten better with each run this time in work and looks to be working up to a maiden victory. Maps nicely for this contest from gate four and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Sure to be right there when the whips are cracking. OUR GIRL SNIP (8) is facing the starter for the first time but has shown ability at the trials and won't need to be a superstar to be competitive against this lot. Respect any market confidence. READY AS BAM (7) put in an improved performance when resuming and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Top-three credentials. NEXT STOP JUPITER (5) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration for a race like this. Can feature while fresh.
